Paladin.description: Righteous defender of justice who strikes down enemies threatening their allies with divine wrath.

features.name: Paladin Cause
features.tldr: Gain the Retributive Strike reaction, punishing enemies that damage your allies.

Redeemer.description: Merciful peacemaker who softens blows and dampens the aggression of wrongdoers.

features.name: Redeemer Cause
features.tldr: Gain the Glimpse of Redemption reaction, forcing attackers to choose between hurting allies or facing resistance/enfeeblement.

Liberator.description: Champion of freedom who breaks bonds, dispels restraints, and helps allies escape peril.

features.name: Liberator Cause
features.tldr: Gain the Liberating Step reaction, allowing allies to escape grabs, restraints, or reposition safely when attacked.
